Built the playable character studio in `index.html`. Nova is set to **1.65 m** by default, with adjustable height, orbit/zoom/pan camera controls, removable outer clothing over a fully covered base suit, color choices, poses, and snapshots.

I used an original, non-explicit adult character rather than reproducing the explicit attachment. I also saved and inspected the verification screenshot at `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

The app is running at **http://localhost:3002**.
